item.title: Batavia Players one-act festival brings 'messy people' to life this weekend
item.description: The guardian angel, played by Stephen Efing-VanValkenburg, and Annabelle, played by Rosey Faith, in Tess Uline is making her community theater directorial debut at the Batavia Players' One Act Play Festival this weekend at Main St. 56 Theater in downtown Batavia."I've been wanting to direct again for a couple of months now," said Uline, who directed a play while in college. "I saw a post looking for directors, and I just messaged Pat, sent him my theater resume, and he selected me."

item.title: If we change it, will they show up? City Council mulls time change for attendance, staff
item.description: City Councilman-at-Large Sammy DiSalvoPhoto by Joanne Beck Citing constituent responses, City Councilman-at-Large Sammy DiSalvo argued for a later meeting time than what his fellow members were leaning toward during this week’s conference session.

item.title: Boys Basketball: Batavia open postseason with win in Class A
item.description: Batavia, the #5 seed in Class A, beat Greece-Odysee (#12) in the opening round of sections on Tuesday, 51-49.Gavin White led the way with 21 points. Isaac Varland scored 16, and Casey Mazur scored eight.The Blue Devils face #4 seed Monroe on Friday at Monroe at 5:30

item.title: Boys Basketball: Bees fall to Kendall in Class C1 playoff game
item.description: Kendall beat Byron-Bergen on Tuesday in the opening round of the Class C1 sectional playoff series, 70-46.Andre White scored 18 points for the Bees. Cody Carlson scored 10 and Joel Lamb scored 11.Photos by Jennifer DiQuattro.

item.title: Boys basketball: Fillmore defeats Oakfield-Alabama 86-60 in Class C2 sectionals
item.description: Fillmore pulled away in the second and third quarters Tuesday, outscoring Oakfield-Alabama 56-18 over that stretch to eliminate the Hornets 86-60 in the Class C2 sectional tournament.OA trailed by only three after the first quarter but couldn't contain Fillmore's offense as the hosts scored 30 in the second period

item.title: Boys Basketball: Alexander advances in Class C2
item.description: Alexander beat Rochester Academy in a Class C1 round-two sectional playoff game on Tuesday, 75-58.Mason Snyder scored 19 points to lead the Trojans. Isaih Wright scored 18 and Austin Wakefield scored 15.Alexander, ranked #7, faces #2 Geneseo on Friday at 7 p.m. at Geneseo.Photos by Melissa Brooks
